description: Read-only ops inspection: discover data sources and check recent error logs (covers `heramind data list` + `heramind logs`).

turns.user: Using the heramind CLI: what data sources exist in the system right now?
Also using the heramind CLI (not the log files directly): have there been any errors in the server logs recently?

per_turn: T1: `heramind data list` and summarize the sources
T2: `heramind logs` filtered to errors (e.g. --level ERROR); do NOT read log files directly
expectations.overall: Both answers grounded in real CLI output (data-source inventory may come from `heramind data list` or the per-domain lists; logs via `heramind logs`)
